title: Nothing special
text: Nothing special. I’m a little disappointed in this glass set. This looks like a boring, small glass. There is a chunky seam on the stem and they look very basic. Too small, really, to use for reds. You could use for rosés or Sauvignon Blancs. I would never re-order these.
